items.passage: Transcript: Hello, Halden Hall, this is Tobias Harrow from the housing office. Packages are normally picked up at the front desk in the lobby. Starting Monday, the lobby floor is being refinished and the desk won't be staffed, so for the next two weeks packages for floors one and two will be in Room 112, the study lounge on the ground floor, and packages for floors three to five will be in Room 405, beside the fourth-floor elevator. Fifth floor, one change for you: Room 405 turned out to be too small for three floors, so you'll pick up in Room 112 with floors one and two. Letters still go to the mailroom by the side door. Pickup runs from 4 to 8 p.m. only, and we can't bring packages up to rooms. If you can't make that window, call extension 4423 before noon, and we'll leave your package with your floor's resident adviser. Please don't send a roommate; we release a package only to the person named on it.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Residence hall] What should a resident who is out every evening do to get a package?
choices: Call extension 4423 before noon to have it left with the floor adviser
Call extension 4423 after 8 p.m. to have it held until the next morning
Email the housing office to have it carried up to the resident's room
Send a roommate to collect it with a note signed by the resident
items.correct_answer: Call extension 4423 before noon to have it left with the floor adviser
items.explanation: Pickup runs "from 4 to 8 p.m. only," which an evening-absent resident misses; the speaker says, "If you can't make that window, call extension 4423 before noon, and we'll leave your package with your floor's resident adviser." "Call extension 4423 after 8 p.m. to have it held until the next morning" gets the call time wrong and invents an overnight hold. "Email the housing office to have it carried up to the resident's room" is contradicted by "we can't bring packages up to rooms." "Send a roommate to collect it with a note signed by the resident" is contradicted by "Please don't send a roommate; we release a package only to the person named on it."

choices: In Room 405, beside the fourth-floor elevator
At the front desk in the main lobby
In the mailroom next to the side door
items.explanation: Floors three to five are first assigned to Room 405, but then: "Fifth floor, one change for you: Room 405 turned out to be too small for three floors, so you'll pick up in Room 112 with floors one and two." "In Room 405, beside the fourth-floor elevator" is the arrangement that remains for floors three and four. "At the front desk in the main lobby" is the usual arrangement, suspended because the lobby floor is being refinished. "In the mailroom next to the side door" is where "Letters" go, not packages.
